title: Increase Tangential Gain to Enhance Turning
statement: By increasing the tangential gain, the robot will be more responsive to the turning required to navigate the chicane obstacles.
mechanism: The tangential gain affects the robot's ability to turn towards the goal, which is crucial in navigating tight turns.
contradicting_evidence: Experiment plan_blind_1: Observed delta=+0.000. Verdict: inconclusive (). (Did not produce statistically distinguishable change)
